title: Darline Graham’s Debate Misstep Tests South Carolina’s Appetite for a Political Newcomer
summary: The South Carolina senator has argued that her lack of political experience is a strength as she runs to succeed her late brother, Lindsey Graham. But a debate misstep has rattled some of her supporters.
